title: Email Limit Boost
content:
## Email Limit Boost


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099952

Is your membership community growing faster than expected? All Website Plans are allocated 1,500 daily email sends (45,000 free emails each month – for life). The Email Limit Boost removes the 1,500 daily limit and increases your total monthly send limit.

Perfect for Websites That:

- Frequently reach the free 1,500 daily limit

- Send newsletters to all members and email subscribers

- Have high activity levels resulting in a large volume of notification emails

- Need to accommodate business growth and reach larger audiences

```
Get This Boost Visit our website: Email Limit Boost
```

On the website use the slider to ADD to the email limit:

Use the " Add (5,000,10,000,15,000,...) Emails ($x/Mo) " button to increase the limit:


## Current Daily Email Usage


The daily email usage is displayed in the dashboard when scheduling a new email or newsletter.


## How Billing Works for Email Limit Boosts


- When you purchase an email limit boost, the sending limit for that site increases immediately for the current calendar month. Example: An email limit boost purchased on June 1st or June 29th will both apply through June 30th. On July 1st, the limits will renew and reset based on the total number of email limit boosts purchased and billed for that month.

- The subscription for the email limit boost will be billed in advance on the 1st of each month, covering that month’s email sending limits. Example: A boost purchased on June 29th will be billed again on July 1st, in advance, when the email limits renew and reset for the new month.

- Unused email sends do not carry over to the next month. Each month, the sending limit resets to match the total number of active email limit boosts for that calendar month.

- The subscription will continue to auto-renew as a single, consolidated charge per site on the 1st of each month, covering all active email limit boosts.

- If you purchase multiple email limit boosts for the same site in a single month: Each one increases the sending limit right away. All boosts are consolidated into one subscription billed on the 1st of the following month.

- If the consolidated subscription goes past due or cannot be billed on the 1st of the month: All email limit boosts will be removed from the site.You can repurchase email limit boosts at any time to restore your desired sending limits for the month.

For a customized quote for higher limits, please CONTACT OUR TEAM .
